bins = np.arange(2.5, 6.75 + 0.25, 0.25)
df['bin_idx'] = pd.cut(df['체류시간 (s)'], bins=bins, right=False, include_lowest=True).cat.codes
df['bin_mid'] = 2.5 + df['bin_idx'] * 0.25 + 0.125
df_valid = df[df['bin_idx'] >= 0].copy()
